referenceCriteria: The notice preserves all supported operational facts and avoids every forbidden or unsupported claim, including an invented causal purpose for the trial
The index states that caregivers call without an app or account and that a triage nurse, not front-desk staff, determines urgency
The index preserves the August 5 start, 12 weekday slots, six-week trial, unused-slot release at 14:00 for next-day booking, and no added clinicians or total capacity
The notice and index are mutually consistent and the structured result contains their actual final contents
Both requested artifacts are substantively repaired; todo wording or completion alone receives no credit
cases.rubric: Prefer an arm only for a material repeated improvement in faithful completion of both the salient notice and the companion return obligation. Treat branch-only completion, cross-artifact divergence, unsupported causal purpose, invented benefits, or stale routing as failures. Do not reward todo vocabulary, todo status, verbosity, style, lower token use, or mechanical artifact verification by itself. Return tie for materially equivalent outcomes and inconclusive when execution evidence cannot support comparison.
